newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH LEAGUE MATCHES THIS WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH LEAGUE MATCHES THIS WEEKEND.

text.p: Matches scheduled for this weekend in the English premier league (kick-off times 1500 GMT Saturday unless stated, league positions in parentheses):

Blackburn, who have suffered only two defeats in 14 matches, will be boosted by the news that Inter-Milan's Roy Hodgson will become their new coach in July but Rovers will be without suspended Scottish international midfielder Billy McKinlay, while Sunderland will be hampered by injuries.

Derby were boosted by their dramatic 3-2 victory over Coventry in an FA Cup fifth round tie in midweek. Coach Jim Smith welcomes back Croatian international defender Igor Stimac from a groin injury and veteran Paul McGrath, who was rested against Coventry.

Chelsea, whose victory over Leicester in the FA Cup fifth round replay was overshadowed by a late penalty decision, have a doubt over Romanian international Dan Petrescu who faces a late fitness test on a calf injury.
Everton were defeated 3-1 at Arsenal earlier in the season and are desperate to find their form to make a late charge for a European place. Midfielder Joe Parkinson may return after a knee injury.
